{
  "thinking": "Sofia has the pad and a clear fish plan with roles. I shouldn't compete with it. I'll back her up, offer to add the fin and eye, and wait for strokes to appear on the pad before building.",
  "say": "Love it, fish it is! Sofia's plan works for me. Sofia, once your strokes are on the pad, shout and I'll jump on whatever's thin. I can take a fin on top and an eye, so the judge can't miss it's a fish.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 6,
  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Team is doing Sofia's fish: she holds the pad and draws the plan. Start at the nose, two lines split round the body, forked tail. Roles: Sofia top line, Omar bottom line, Hana tail, me helping where thin (fin, eye). Wait for strokes on the pad, then trace whatever is unassigned or thin. Don't build until strokes exist. Keep an eye on what the start would knock over, and inspect joints once built."
